semiconductor_relevance: High — NEXTIN specializes in wafer inspection systems crucial for defect detection in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: NEXTIN, Inc. is a leading manufacturer of wafer inspection systems that provide advanced defect detection solutions for both traditional and 3-dimensional semiconductor fabrication processes. Their AEGIS and IRIS systems are designed to enhance yield and quality in semiconductor production, particularly for memory and logic devices.
capabilities: AEGIS wafer inspection systems with 30nm sensitivity
IRIS wafer inspection systems for 3D memory devices
KROKY series for thin crack detection
ASPER series for Cu-to-Cu direct bonding with 50nm sensitivity
